audit.action: cite a better source for the same coding
audit.reasoning: The fixed-initial (fixed-strict) coding rests on the standard reference grammar (Emeneau 1955, UCPL 12, 302 pp.), which we hold in full and whose deciding passage (p. 8 section 2.10) plus three corroborating loci (2.4, 2.13, 2.37) I confirmed verbatim in the held scanned. Emeneau's statement is unambiguous: first-syllable stress, mechanically placeable, with vowel-length contrast licensed only in the accented initial syllable. No better or later dedicated source on Kolami prosody exists in Glottolog's bibliography or in the Semantic Scholar/Crossref/archive.org/Bing searches I could run (web lookups quota was exhausted, so Google coverage is a gap). Two open items fetched sources now (Sjoberg 1971 ERIC report; Grierson LSI extract) are silent on Kolami specifically.
